record.paper_title: Bounded compact and dual compact approximation properties of Hardy spaces: new results and open problems
record.context_brief: Exact norms of Fejér and Poisson approximation operators on L^p and H^p
record.original_question: For each integer n ≥ 0 and each real number r with 0 ≤ r < 1, determine the exact operator norms of I - K_n and I - P_r on the Lebesgue spaces L^p for 1 < p < ∞, where K_n is convolution with the n-th Fejér kernel and P_r is convolution with the Poisson kernel. Also determine the exact operator norms of I - K_n and I - P_r on the Hardy spaces H^p for 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞.

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.2. Let n ∈ Z+ and r ∈ [0, 1). Find the exact values of kI − KnkB(Lp) and kI − PrkB(Lp) for 1 < p < ∞, and of kI − KnkB(Hp) and kI − PrkB(Hp) for 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{T} = \mathbb{R}/2\pi\mathbb{Z}$ denote the unit circle equipped with normalized Lebesgue measure. For an integer $n \ge 0$, define the $n$-th Fejér kernel
$$K_n(t) = \sum_{k=-n}^{n}\Big(1 - \frac{|k|}{n+1}\Big)e^{ikt} = \frac{1}{n+1}\left(\frac{\sin\frac{(n+1)t}{2}}{\sin\frac{t}{2}}\right)^2,$$
and for $r \in [0,1)$ define the Poisson kernel
$$P_r(t) = \sum_{k\in\mathbb{Z}} r^{|k|} e^{ikt} = \frac{1-r^2}{1-2r\cos t + r^2}.$$
Let $K_n$ and $P_r$ denote the corresponding convolution operators $f \mapsto K_n * f$ and $f \mapsto P_r * f$, and let $I$ denote the identity operator.

For $1 \le p \le \infty$, let $L^p = L^p(\mathbb{T})$ be the usual Lebesgue space, and let $H^p \subset L^p$ denote the Hardy space of those $f \in L^p$ whose negative Fourier coefficients vanish (with $H^\infty$ defined as the corresponding weak-$*$ closed subspace of $L^\infty$).

Determine, in closed form, the exact operator norms
$$\|I - K_n\|_{\mathcal{B}(L^p)} \quad\text{and}\quad \|I - P_r\|_{\mathcal{B}(L^p)} \quad \text{for every } 1 < p < \infty,$$
and
$$\|I - K_n\|_{\mathcal{B}(H^p)} \quad\text{and}\quad \|I - P_r\|_{\mathcal{B}(H^p)} \quad \text{for every } 1 \le p \le \infty,$$
as functions of $n \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$, $r \in [0,1)$, and $p$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is explicitly posed as an open problem about determining exact operator norms of $I - K_n$ and $I - P_r$ on $L^p$ and $H^p$ spaces. No closed-form solutions for these norms appear in the literature; only bounds and asymptotics are known. The status appears to remain open.
